title: Mind Map Page
purpose: Explore an argument and edit its structure where you read it.
audience: People thinking with a structured map
product: An interactive map page with node editing, drawing previews, and configuration export.
steps: Move from the workflow to sections and leaves.
Rename a node, add a child, or remove a leaf.
Open the drawing attached to a leaf.
Save in this browser or export the map configuration.
checks: Rename and add-child operations appear immediately.
Saved edits survive a reload in the same browser.
Exported configuration can be imported back.
example: A delivery design workflow with linked Studio and Gallery drawings.
open: Should editing a map create a new review round automatically?
